label: Metabolic Rhythm and Visceral Tissue Regeneration (40+)
description: Early metabolic dysfunction protocol. Focus: circadian rhythm restoration, fascia-peritoneum health, autonomic recalibration, mitochondrial recovery. NOT weight loss or cosmetic medicine.

core_hypothesis.statement: Visceral fat is a stress-adaptation marker, not a primary fat disorder.
primary_drivers: peritoneal and abdominal fascia hypometabolism ('cold tissue')
core_hypothesis.fat_accumulation_model: protective buffering state — body adapts to energy/rhythm deficit
core_hypothesis.tcm_backend: Yangming + Taiyin axis hypometabolism. Spleen-Stomach insufficient to process and transform. Yang deficiency → cold tissue accumulation.
core_hypothesis.ayurvedic_backend: Ama accumulation (undigested metabolic waste). Kapha excess. Agni (metabolic fire) reduced. Pachaka Pitta insufficiency.

who_fits: central weight gain / increased waist circumference
poor sleep quality or circadian drift
exclusions: structural abdominal wall defects (hernia, significant diastasis)
advanced metabolic disease requiring pharmacologic management
